argv:
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
for e in smp2p_negotiate smp2p_notify_in smp2p_ssr_ack smp2p_update_bits; do
  printf '\nEVENT=%s\n' "$e"
  cat "/sys/kernel/tracing/events/qcom_smp2p/$e/format"
  printf 'ENABLE='; cat "/sys/kernel/tracing/events/qcom_smp2p/$e/enable"
  printf 'FILTER='; cat "/sys/kernel/tracing/events/qcom_smp2p/$e/filter"
done
printf 'TRACER='; cat /sys/kernel/tracing/current_tracer
printf 'INSTANCES\n'; ls /sys/kernel/tracing/instances
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
